result:
Both findings are fixed, and every acceptance check I was asked to run exits 0. The changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. Neither finding is closed: qa or another non-author has to verify them in round 7.

**F-DG5-148 (long record names on Traceability and Modular entry)**
- **Cause:** user-entered record names were shown as inline text that could not break. The overflowing link qa saw is the graph node link on the Traceability page, which wraps `RecordName`.
- **Fix:** `RecordName` (`traceability/ui.tsx:115-131`) now renders inside a `record-name` span, and the Modular missing-item label (`ModularPage.tsx:235`) gets the same class. In `app.css` that class wraps anywhere (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`).
- **Other `RecordName` uses:** all 8 get the fix through the component: `TraceabilityPage.tsx:173/202/214/335` and `TracePanels.tsx:173/371/413/583`.
- **`min-inline-size: 0`:** not needed here, because none of these sites is a flex or grid item.

**F-DG5-149 (Define outcome card too wide at 320–375 px)**
- **Cause:** each outcome is a grid item, and grid items won't shrink below their content by default. The widest content was the bare Good-outcome table, which held the card at about 352 px.
- **Fix:** the table now sits in `TableScrollRegion` (`DefinePage.tsx:526, 544-571`), which is focusable and named in en and ar using existing text keys. `.outcome-tree > .outcome-node { min-inline-size: 0 }` (`app.css:1400-1405`) lets the card shrink to the column.
- **Unit guard:** `GoodOutcomeTest` is off the pending list in `table-regions.test.tsx`, so the guard now requires the Define table to be in a scroll region.

**Regression tests (failed before the fix, pass after)**
- **New e2e spec `apps/web/e2e/p5-record-name-reflow.spec.ts`:** Traceability and Modular entry with the 120-character word, the 46-character token, the unbroken Arabic token and ordinary text, plus Define with ordinary text. It runs at 390, 360 and 320 px and at 200 % text (Define also at 375 px), in en and ar, and asserts `scrollWidth - innerWidth <= 1`.
- **Before:** it failed 4/4, and the numbers match qa's exactly: Traceability 823/893/1658 px, Modular 761/831/1589 px, Define en 61/21/6 px and ar 29 px.
- **Revised mid-run:** the first before-fix run stopped Define at a thrown region check before it measured overflow. I changed that check to be collected with the other failures and re-ran, so the overflow failure is now recorded. Both runs are logged.
- **After:** 4/4 pass with 0 px overflow everywhere.
- **Unit guard:** 1 failed / 8 passed against the old Define page, and 9 passed after the fix.

**Checks**

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `validate --historical --stage DG4`, start and end | 0 | `PASS gate DG4 (historical)` |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | 0 | |
| `pnpm -r build` | 0 | |
| `pnpm lint` | 0 | |
| prettier check | 0 | all files formatted |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | 846 operations |
| `unit-web`, locale unset | 0 | 90 files, 1713 passed |
| `unit-web`, C.UTF-8 | 0 | 90 files, 1713 passed |
| 5 e2e specs, real stack, `--workers=1`, locale unset | 0 | 18 passed (9 en + 9 ar), 0 failed, 0 flaky |
| 5 e2e specs, real stack, `--workers=1`, C.UTF-8 | 0 | 18 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky |
| `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration`, full e2e suite | — | not run, D-164 |

I looked at the screenshots for 320 px in en and ar. They show the names wrapping and the Define card fitting with its table in a bordered scroll region.

There is no contract, schema or dependency change and no new or changed user text. No ADR statement becomes untrue. The only follow-up for the architect is optional: an ADR could add `.record-name` to its list of wrapping title containers. Nothing in scope remains; the run took about 55 minutes.

One thing you might trip over: untracked dotfiles at the repo root (`.bashrc`, `.zshrc`, `.idea`, `CLAUDE.local.md` and others) were already there when I started. I didn't create or touch them, so leave them out of the integration.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/`:
- T-DG5-FE-AB1-frontend-ux-engineer.md
- T-DG5-FE-AB1-evidence/ (logs, and screenshots under `shots/en/` and `shots/ar/`)
